title: 戦術的おすすめレシピ

text_block_list.text: One day, Hishi Amazon is walking through the shopping district, when…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Get your cabbages here! They're fresh, crunchy, and delicious to boot—don't miss out on this bargain!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, this a surprise. What brings you here, Biko?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm helping bring in some customers for this shop! The weather was so good that they harvested way too many cabbages.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: They're having a hard time selling off all the remaining stock, so I figured a hero should swoop in to save the day!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Now that's a good mindset to have! I'll take two off your hands.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But just two won't make much of a dent. I'll help bring in some customers myself.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Get your cabbages cheap! Hey there, how about buying some cabbages today?

text_block_list.name: Female Shopper
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I'm cooking hamburger steaks tonight. I've already bought the meat, so…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm… Why not have this on the side, then?

text_block_list.name: Female Shopper
text_block_list.text: Well, my children aren't very fond of vegetables. Even the sight of greens makes them upset.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Just the sight of them?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: How's this? You could dice up the cabbage and blend it into the meat for the hamburger steaks.

text_block_list.name: Female Shopper
text_block_list.text: Oh, I bet even my little picky eaters would be okay with that. I'll take some!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hishiama, sounds like this customer is struggling with an upset stomach.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, pot-au-feu could do 'em some good. It's warming, and cabbage helps a lot with digestion.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And how about you? You're lookin' for something cheap and filling? Twice-cooked pork is your best bet!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: And we're all sold out! That was some amazing work, Hishiama! You could be Cabbage Ranger, solving problems one cabbage at a time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Please don't call me "Cabbage Ranger"… Anyway, I'm glad I could help.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You know, the way I had to change up my tactics to match each customer's needs could work just as well for my racing!
Hishi Amazon broadens her strategic skills following today's events.
